Evan: Observed a regional spike in mtls handshake_failure (TLS alert 40) for svc-gateway -> svc-core eu-west around 11:03 UTC. Traces show KMS Decrypt errors and a couple of HSM unavailability notices. Anyone on keystore or rotation?

Marta: We did an HSM-backed key promotion earlier at 10:45 (rolling promote to use HSM key version v3). I validated cert issuance in us region but didn't run a full multi-region smoke.

Jae: Logs: `KMS Decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED` for principal=svc-gateway@eu-prod against projects/.../cryptoKeys/mtls-gateway-key and occasional `HSM_UNAVAILABLE` entries during v3 activation window.

Evan: Could be two issues: 1) the HSM key version requires a different IAM binding (service account omission), 2) brief HSM backend flapping during promotion. Which seems likelier?

Marta: Checking git history of the keystore IAM PR. I see the new binding only added `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypter` for the promotion role but missed `cryptoKeyDecrypter` for region-specific service accounts. Oops.

security-oncall: Immediate mitigations: enable gateway fallback to ephemeral certs (`--mtls-fallback=ephemeral`) for eu-west, and set SLO alert for KMS decrypt denies. Also, add back explicit decrypt binding for svc-gateway@eu-prod.

Jae: Applied ephemeral fallback to eu-west gateway canary and restarted one pod. Handshake failures dropped from ~6% -> 0.5% on that canary.

deploy-bot: iam-deploy: PR #2984 (add decrypt binding for svc-gateway) opened by Marta.

Marta: I'll include a small CI smoke in the PR that runs `gcloud kms decrypt` with the gateway SA against a test key version to validate permissions pre-merge. ETA 25m.

Evan: Note for runbook: when promoting to HSM-backed key versions, include multi-region permission check and stagger the promotion to avoid simultaneous backend retries. Also log the audit query we used: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND protoPayload.request.name:mtls-gateway-key` (saved).

security-oncall: Follow-ups: 1) Marta to merge PR and verify canary (ETA 30m). 2) Add CI pre-merge smoke and update RBAC checklist (Marta/Jae). 3) Instrument keystore client to emit `keystore.decrypt.denies{principal,region}` (product backlog).

Marta: Merged PR after canary passed. Rolling back ephemeral fallback flag once propagation stable. Will file SEC-2026-411 with timeline and remediation steps.

Evan: Thanks everyone. Two takeaways: verify IAM for every key version change, and consider HSM promotion window telemetry to detect backend flapping earlier.

Jae: Adding a short note: HSM promotions can cause transient latency spikes; prefer rolling promotion with progressive verification.

security-oncall: Closing chat; will convert to a formal incident if we see recurrence.
